supplements.title: Naringenin suppresses colorectal Cancer progression by targeting the Gankyrin/PI3K /AKT/GSK-3β/β-catenin signaling Axis.
supplements.summary: Naringenin, a citrus compound, suppresses colorectal cancer by blocking a key protein pathway involved in tumor growth and spread.

supplements.title: Hederagenin suppresses inflammation-cancer transformation in chronic atrophic gastritis by modulating glycolysis through the mTOR/HIF-1α axis.
supplements.summary: Hederagenin, a natural compound, slows gastric cancer development in chronic atrophic gastritis by reducing inflammation and abnormal cell energy metabolism.

supplements.title: Maternal Choline Supplementation in a Mouse Model of Down Syndrome and Alzheimer's Disease Generates Unique Expression Profile Mosaics Within Three Hippocampal Excitatory Neuronal Populations.
supplements.summary: Maternal choline supplementation reduces harmful cell death and boosts cognitive pathways in mouse models of Down syndrome and Alzheimer's disease.

supplements.title: Chrysophanol attenuates breast cancer angiogenesis through blocking VEGFA/VEGFR2/ERK activation via inhibiting ACE2 ubiquitination.
supplements.summary: Chrysophanol, a natural compound, slows breast cancer growth by blocking blood vessel formation through a specific molecular pathway.

supplements.title: Identification of monomethylsulochrin as a novel agent to ameliorate DSS-induced ulcerative colitis through dual modulation of the IL-17/TNF pathway and gut microbiota.
supplements.summary: Monomethylsulochrin, a natural compound, reduces ulcerative colitis symptoms by suppressing inflammation and restoring healthy gut bacteria in mice.

supplements.title: Senkyunolide I inhibits abdominal aortic aneurysm via PARP-1-targeted restraint of large peritoneal macrophage migration.
supplements.summary: Senkyunolide I, a plant compound, may help prevent abdominal aortic aneurysm by blocking immune cell movement.

supplements.title: Potential immunomodulatory and antitumor properties of hydatid cysts components.
supplements.summary: Hydatid cyst components stimulate immune responses that may suppress cancer growth through cross-reactivity with tumor antigens.

supplements.title: Fucoidan alleviates chemotherapy-induced steatohepatitis by regulating the gut-liver axis.
supplements.summary: Fucoidan protects the liver from chemotherapy damage by strengthening the intestinal barrier and reducing harmful inflammation.

supplements.title: Oridonin downregulates PD-L1 expression and promotes anti-tumor immunity via inhibiting NLRP3 and STAT3.
supplements.summary: Oridonin, a natural product, reduces PD-L1 cancer cell protein levels and boosts immune cell anti-tumor activity in mice.

supplements.title: Emodin retards renal cyst progression in ADPKD by inhibiting cell proliferation and decreasing oxidative stress.
supplements.summary: Emodin, derived from rhubarb, slows kidney cyst growth in ADPKD by reducing cell proliferation and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Quercetin alleviates imatinib-induced premature ovarian insufficiency by regulating mitophagy via the ROS/JNK/c-JUN pathway.
supplements.summary: Quercetin protects ovaries from damage caused by imatinib, a cancer drug, by reducing harmful oxidative stress and excessive cell death.

supplements.title: Identification and mechanistic insights into immunomodulatory peptides from soft-shelled turtle hydrolysates.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified two peptides from soft-shelled turtle that reduce inflammation and support healthy gut bacteria, offering potential therapeutic food ingredients.

supplements.title: Unlocking the potential of functional food polysaccharides: The zebrafish model as a revolutionary high-throughput screening platform.
supplements.summary: Zebrafish provide a cost-effective screening platform to quickly test polysaccharides from food for cancer-fighting and health benefits.

supplements.title: Anti-inflammatory activity of quinoa-based protein beverage after INFOGEST digestion: Peptide identification and molecular docking-based screening.
supplements.summary: Quinoa protein beverages release anti-inflammatory peptides during digestion that reduce inflammation signaling better than purified quinoa protein alone.

supplements.title: Microwave Plasma Torch Desorption Ionization Mass Spectrometry for Chemical Constituents of Pinellia ternata (Thunb.) Ten. ex Breitenb.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a mass spectrometry technique to identify chemical compounds in Pinellia ternata, a traditional herb with potential anti-tumor properties.

off_label.title: Lansoprazole Enhances Everolimus Efficacy Through DDIT3-Mediated PI3K/AKT/mTOR Pathway Inhibition in Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Neoplasms Proliferation.
off_label.summary: Lansoprazole combined with everolimus more effectively treats pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors by blocking cancer growth pathways.

off_label.title: Clofibrate inhibits tumor immune escape by increasing macrophage phagocytosis.
off_label.summary: Clofibrate blocks lung cancer's immune escape by reducing CD47 protein, allowing immune cells to destroy tumors more effectively.

off_label.title: Unacylated Ghrelin Counteracts Mitochondrial Dysfunction and Neuromuscular Junction Disruption in Cancer Cachexia.
off_label.summary: Unacylated ghrelin treatment preserves muscle mass and function in lung cancer mice by restoring mitochondrial health and reducing muscle breakdown.

off_label.title: FDPS links tumor progression, phosphoproteomic reprogramming, and therapeutic vulnerability in hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: FDPS protein drives liver cancer growth, and blocking it with pamidronate drug slows tumors in mice.

off_label.title: GLP-1RA plus SGLT2i combination therapy and liver fibrosis progression in MASLD with type 2 diabetes.
off_label.summary: Combining two diabetes drugs may slow liver fibrosis progression better than using one drug alone in patients with fatty liver disease.

off_label.title: Gastroenterology/Hepatology: What You May Have Missed in 2025.
off_label.summary: Exercise after colon cancer surgery and treatment reduces recurrence and improves survival in patients.

off_label.title: Associations of aspirin use with pancreatic cancer risk: a meta-analysis of cohort studies with exploratory population- and exposure-stratified analyses.
off_label.summary: Aspirin use is associated with reduced pancreatic cancer risk, particularly in people with diabetes, normal weight, and non-drinkers.

off_label.title: Severe Pharyngo-Laryngeal Mucositis During Radiotherapy in a Patient Receiving Colchicine: A Case Report.
off_label.summary: Colchicine use during radiotherapy for throat cancer unexpectedly worsened mouth and throat damage, suggesting a dangerous drug-radiation interaction.

off_label.title: Pharmacokinetic Prediction of Repurposed Drugs for PDAC Using Artificial Intelligence.
off_label.summary: AI models accurately predict how repurposed drugs behave in the body for pancreatic cancer treatment.

off_label.title: Targeting TMPRSS2 for Prostate Cancer Therapy: A Multi-Step Computational Approach for Identifying Novel Inhibitors.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified promising drug candidates to block TMPRSS2, a protein that drives prostate cancer growth and spread.

off_label.title: Multiscale analysis and optimal glioma therapeutic candidate discovery using the CANDO platform.
off_label.summary: Researchers used the CANDO computational platform to discover 24 promising glioma drug candidates by analyzing how compounds interact with brain tumor proteins.

off_label.title: Studying Synergistic Anticancer Effects of Repurposed AT1B Losartan with Antidiabetics Metformin, Rosiglitazone in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Cells.
off_label.summary: Losartan combined with metformin shows synergistic effects in killing triple-negative breast cancer cells more effectively than either drug alone.

off_label.title: Avapritinib for targeting KIT D816V-mutated acute myeloid leukemia relapsed after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant with extramedullary and central nervous system involvement.
off_label.summary: Drug avapritinib effectively treats relapsed acute myeloid leukemia with specific KIT mutation, even in brain and multiple organs.

off_label.title: NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy: emerging role and novel therapeutic target in precision oncology.
off_label.summary: NCOA4-mediated ferritin breakdown triggers iron-dependent cancer cell death, offering a new treatment strategy to overcome drug resistance.

off_label.title: Targeting CB1 and TRPM8 receptors to counteract CD8+ T cell exhaustion.
off_label.summary: Blocking CB1 receptors reduced exhaustion markers on immune cells, potentially improving cancer treatment effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Chemotherapy-Induced Gastrointestinal Dysfunction: Mechanisms and Integrative Western-Chinese Medicine Strategies.
biomarkers.summary: Chemotherapy damages the gut through multiple interconnected processes; combined Western and Chinese medicine approaches targeting specific mechanisms may better prevent and treat these side effects.

biomarkers.title: Naringenin suppresses colorectal Cancer progression by targeting the Gankyrin/PI3K /AKT/GSK-3β/β-catenin signaling Axis.
biomarkers.summary: Naringenin, a citrus compound, suppresses colorectal cancer by blocking a key protein pathway involved in tumor growth and spread.

biomarkers.title: A plasma-based DNA test for quantification of disease burden in acute myeloid leukemia patients undergoing bone marrow transplantation.
biomarkers.summary: A blood test detecting leukemia mutations predicts relapse and treatment response better than standard tests in AML transplant patients.

biomarkers.title: A phase 1 study of ASTX727 plus talazoparib in patients with triple-negative or hormone resistant/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Combined DNMT and PARP inhibitors show promise in early testing for triple-negative and hormone-resistant breast cancer with normal BRCA genes.

biomarkers.title: Feasibility of improving sLe(a)/CA 19-9 harmonization by recalibration: a simulation study using three EQA programs.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that recalibration could improve consistency of CA 19-9 blood tests used to monitor pancreatic and gastrointestinal cancers.

biomarkers.title: GPNMB Drives Brain Metastasis by Sculpting a Pathological Endothelial-Immune Interactome.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found GPNMB protein drives brain metastasis in lung cancer and melanoma by disrupting the blood-brain barrier, and blocking it combined with immunotherapy improved treatment outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Early cancer detection in a large American Cancer Society cohort study: Retrospective analysis of methylated DNA biomarkers.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that DNA methylation patterns in blood plasma can detect cancer earlier, using samples from a large cancer study cohort.

biomarkers.title: Clinical strategies for lymphoma management: Recommendations from the Bridging the Gaps in Leukemia, Lymphoma, and Multiple Myeloma Consensus Conference 2025.
biomarkers.summary: Experts recommend tailored lymphoma treatments including new drug combinations for mantle cell lymphoma and personalized monitoring strategies for chronic lymphocytic leukemia and diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

biomarkers.title: Preclinical circulating tumor DNA shedding duration and prognostic implications of modeling 3669 patients with cancer in the American Cancer Society Cancer Prevention Study-3 and Circulating Cell-Free Genome Atlas Substudy 3.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers measured how long circulating tumor DNA appears before cancer symptoms, crucial for developing early detection blood tests across multiple cancer types.

biomarkers.title: Clinical and immunological significance of FOXO1 as a biomarker of improved response to immune checkpoint plus tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy in metastatic renal cell carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: High FOXO1 levels predict better treatment response in kidney cancer patients receiving combined immunotherapy and targeted drug therapy.

biomarkers.title: Lymphocyte Antigen 6G Mediates Vagotomy-Associated Reduction in Body Weight.
biomarkers.summary: Cutting the vagus nerve reduces body weight through immune cells called Ly6G+ cells in fat tissue.

biomarkers.title: Hederagenin suppresses inflammation-cancer transformation in chronic atrophic gastritis by modulating glycolysis through the mTOR/HIF-1α axis.
biomarkers.summary: Hederagenin, a natural compound, slows gastric cancer development in chronic atrophic gastritis by reducing inflammation and abnormal cell energy metabolism.

biomarkers.summary: Maternal choline supplementation reduces harmful cell death and boosts cognitive pathways in mouse models of Down syndrome and Alzheimer's disease.

biomarkers.title: Metabolic Response to CDK4/6 Inhibition in ER+ Breast Cancer Creates a Therapeutic Vulnerability in Drug-Tolerant Persister Cells.
biomarkers.summary: CDK4/6 inhibitors increase mitochondrial activity in drug-resistant breast cancer cells, creating a vulnerability that can be exploited by targeting mitochondrial respiration.

biomarkers.title: Lansoprazole Enhances Everolimus Efficacy Through DDIT3-Mediated PI3K/AKT/mTOR Pathway Inhibition in Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Neoplasms Proliferation.
biomarkers.summary: Lansoprazole combined with everolimus more effectively treats pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors by blocking cancer growth pathways.

trials.summary: Deep learning models using kidney cancer CT scans can better predict patient survival when using balanced data splitting and multiple image enhancement techniques.

trials.title: Antigen-induced IL-12 potentiates piggyBac-engineered HER2-CAR-T cells against gastric cancer.
trials.summary: Antigen-triggered IL-12 boosts engineered CAR-T cells' effectiveness against gastric cancer while maintaining safer, controlled immune activation.

trials.title: Design and synthesis of c-Met/PARP dual-target inhibitors for the treatment of BRCA wild-type TNBC.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a dual-target drug inhibiting c-Met and PARP that effectively treated triple-negative breast cancer without BRCA mutations.

trials.title: Inhibiting CK2 in breast cancer: From molecular targets to drug candidates.
trials.summary: Blocking the CK2 protein shows promise for treating breast cancer, especially hormone-resistant and triple-negative forms, though drug selectivity remains challenging.

trials.title: CXCL9 as a key feature for deep learning-based immune subtyping and prediction of immune checkpoint blockade response in triple-negative breast cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers identified CXCL9 as a key marker to better predict which triple-negative breast cancer patients will respond to immunotherapy.

trials.title: Design and evaluation of selective BET PROTACs with potent antitumor efficacy and safety against acute myeloid leukemia.
trials.summary: Researchers developed new BET-degrading drugs called PROTACs that effectively shrink acute myeloid leukemia tumors with improved safety compared to conventional inhibitors.

mind_body.title: Chemotherapy-Induced Gastrointestinal Dysfunction: Mechanisms and Integrative Western-Chinese Medicine Strategies.
mind_body.summary: Chemotherapy damages the gut through multiple interconnected processes; combined Western and Chinese medicine approaches targeting specific mechanisms may better prevent and treat these side effects.

mind_body.title: Effects of Mindfulness-Based Interventions on the Psychological Well-Being of Family Caregivers of Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
mind_body.summary: Mindfulness-based interventions significantly reduce anxiety and depression in family caregivers of cancer patients.

mind_body.title: eHealth Mindfulness-based Music Therapy Intervention for Patients Undergoing Stem Cell Transplantation
mind_body.summary: Researchers are testing an online mindfulness and music therapy program to improve quality of life in blood cancer patients undergoing stem cell transplants.

mind_body.title: Community-Engaged Pilot Testing of Talking About Cancer (TAC) to Improve Engagement in Advance Care Planning
mind_body.summary: Telephone coaching helps advanced cancer patients and caregivers plan end-of-life care through guided conversations and advance directives.

mind_body.title: Dehydration in the Dying Process: An Integrative Systematic Review of Physiological Mechanisms and Clinical Implications.
mind_body.summary: Terminal dehydration in dying patients is an adaptive process; artificial hydration increases respiratory secretions and discomfort without clear benefits.

mind_body.title: Psychotherapeutic Techniques for Dyspnea in Cancer and Chronic Illness: Systematic Review.
mind_body.summary: Psychotherapy techniques effectively help cancer and seriously ill patients manage breathing difficulties, though delivery methods need better understanding.

mind_body.title: Pilot study of the DeStress for Health Program: a community-engaged stress reduction and cancer prevention intervention for rural communities.
mind_body.summary: A stress-reduction program showed promise in helping rural communities adopt healthier behaviors that could lower cancer risk.

mind_body.title: AI-enabled psychometric and psychophysiological assessment in psychiatric comorbidity of oncology patients: A systematic review.
mind_body.summary: AI tools can better detect depression and anxiety in cancer patients by continuously monitoring psychological distress beyond traditional screening methods.

mind_body.title: Association of postoperative psychological interventions on compliance and survival in breast cancer patients: A single-center retrospective study.
mind_body.summary: Early structured psychological support after breast cancer surgery significantly improved patient adherence to hormone therapy and showed survival benefits.

mind_body.title: Communication skill training in surgical residency: insights from Y-SICO (Young-Italian Society of Surgical Oncology).
mind_body.summary: Most surgical residents lack formal communication training despite recognizing its importance for delivering difficult diagnoses and managing patient care.

mind_body.title: Beyond tumor biology: nursing interventions for psychological and immune health in cancer patients.
mind_body.summary: Nursing interventions combining therapy, mindfulness, and lifestyle support improve psychological well-being and immune function in cancer patients.

mind_body.title: Breast cancer survivor and body: Exploring self-defining memories in an intervention pilot study.
mind_body.summary: A new psychological intervention helps breast cancer survivors process traumatic body-related memories and improve well-being.

mind_body.title: Five-Element Music and VR for Pain and Psychological Distress in Advanced Cancer: A Randomized Trial.
mind_body.summary: Music therapy and virtual reality together reduced pain and psychological distress in advanced cancer patients more effectively than standard care alone.

mind_body.title: Digital and AI-enhanced psychosocial interventions in breast cancer patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Digital and AI-based mental health programs help reduce stress and anxiety in breast cancer patients, improving their overall well-being.

mind_body.title: How does self-compassion affect posttraumatic adaptation among lymphoma patients? A perspective based on network analysis.
mind_body.summary: Self-compassion components distinctly influence posttraumatic stress and growth differently in lymphoma patients through network analysis.
